title: vigil.config/v0
description: Vigil configuration (YAML). Strict: unknown keys are errors. No field accepts a URL or a selector; backend addresses live only in the off-repo overlay, keyed by the ids declared here.

listen.description: host:port. Default 127.0.0.1:10082. One explicit IPv4 or bracketed IPv6 literal; wildcard is always rejected, and a non-loopback address additionally needs the non-loopback flag and a read token at startup.

backends.description: Named backends. An id declared here is the only way to reach an address, and the address itself is in the overlay.

authorities.description: Documents whose own severity is combined into overall. Vigil derives none of it.

sources.description: Informational documents. They never colour overall.

queries.description: Named PromQL. Host slug is the only template variable; there is no free-form path over HTTP or on the CLI.

stale_after.description: Global age bound for authority and informational documents. Default 120s; an authority may override it.

read_file.description: Path to the read token. Required on every /v0/* route regardless of bind. The environment variable of the same meaning overrides it.

signal_file.description: Path to the write (signal) token. Required for POST /v0/signals.

locator.description: An environment indirection or an absolute path. Never a URL, never a relative path, no traversal.

expr.description: PromQL with at most the {{.host}} template variable. Any other brace sequence is rejected, so a selector or a second variable cannot be smuggled through a named query.

timeout.description: Per-query deadline in seconds, 1..10, default 5. Sent as the API timeout parameter and enforced by a client deadline.

max_series.description: Default 200. Vigil requests limit=max_series+1 and fails with series_cap above the bound.
